title: Plan semantic Dolt checkpoint projection for history diffs
description:
Current Dolt checkpoints preserve restore/fork correctness by storing serialized SQLite snapshot rows. That is good for recovery, but not ideal for semantic 'what changed in the campaign?' diffs.

Plan, but do not necessarily implement immediately, a semantic projection layer for key campaign tables alongside the restore-safe snapshot format.
acceptance_criteria:
- Current snapshot format remains the restore authority.
- Design describes optional semantic Dolt tables/projections.
- Design explains which entities are useful for history diffs.
- Work is clearly deferred unless needed for near-term history UX.
close_reason: Design delivered: docs/checkpoint-semantic-projection.md plans an optional, deferred semantic projection layer (per-entity identity-keyed proj_* Dolt tables, atomic same-repo commit) while campaign_snapshot remains the sole restore authority. Documents diff-worthy entities, schema-drift handling, secret/no-churn omissions, integration points, cost/risk, reversibility. Implementation gated on a real history UX. PR #170.
